items.title: Replacement-worker all-clients-close drill
items.evidence: Engineering deployed successor shell shell-093b56870d7220008b559673 while owner kept locked Live open. Owner confirmed active Live and Previous/Next were not interrupted. After all V2 clients closed, owner reopened online; screenshots show unchanged active bootstrap generation, 12/12 chunks, offline restart available, and service worker current. Owner then confirmed a successor offline cold launch. Engineering restored checkpoint shell shell-39849548e3b7192a1c76aa6e and verified V1/V2 active, checkpoint executable/unit hashes, bootstrap SHA, and checkpoint sw.js release. Status UI exposes only the generic shell cache prefix, so exact client release was established by controlled server deployment plus lifecycle behavior, not inferred from that field.
